title: bash_history
description: Exported by Interlinear 0.1.0 from bash_history. The steps follow the transcript's line order; each cites its transcript lines and gloss sources.

steps.description: Line 1 (rule; operator): Checks which user the session is running as.
Line 3 (rule; operator): Downloads a file from a remote host to disk.
Line 5 (rule; operator): Makes a file executable, typically a payload that was just downloaded.
Line 7 (rule; operator): Lists local user accounts.
Line 8 (rule; operator): Adds an SSH key so the attacker can log in again later.
Line 10 (rule; operator): Stops the shell from recording commands.
Line 11 (rule; operator): Erases the shell command history to hide what was run.
